title: Two Up-Close Bigfoot Encounters Reported Over The Span Of Two Days In Pennsylvania

content:
Two different witnesses in southwest Pennsylvania recently claimed to have seen Bigfoot on successive days, and each one shared exactly what they saw. Both sightings occurred during daylight hours and happened in close proximity to the witnesses.

The first Bigfoot encounter reportedly happened at a farm in Indiana County, Pennsylvania, on the evening of August 18, according to researcher Stan Gordon. The witness claims that when she emerged from a building on the property after hearing “a disturbance coming from the wood line,” she saw two creatures “crouching behind trees approximately sixty feet away.”

When the witness sneezed, the creatures stopped interacting, paused, and turned to face her. Their response alarmed her, so she bolted inside. Her husband attested that his wife rushed into the house right after the incident, screaming about what she had just seen.

Around 4:30 p.m. on the day of the Bigfoot encounter, the witness’s husband was walking their dog when he heard a loud wood-knocking sound near a cornfield. He then heard three more knocks coming from the top of a nearby ridge. Bigfoot encounters are frequently linked to the phenomenon of tree knocking, which is frequently described as intentional and consistent.

The second Bigfoot sighting was similar to the first one

The next evening, on August 19, a driver in nearby Westmoreland County, Pennsylvania, reported seeing “a hair-covered creature running rapidly up a hillside on the right side of the road.” The Bigfoot in this case had “charcoal-gray hair” and, like the creatures from the day before, long arms and almost no neck.

When the figure reached the roadway, the witness estimated that she was around thirty feet away. It seemed to momentarily lose its balance as it stepped onto the ground next to the road, then made a 180-degree turn. The witness reported that the Bigfoot’s whole body twisted in an unusual manner. She likened the motion to being mechanical. The creature then rushed back down the hill.

Stan Gordon noted that he interviewed both witnesses within one hour of their respective Bigfoot encounters. Additionally, Gordon said Bigfoot sightings have traditionally originated from the geographical areas where these encounters took place.
